payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the adaptively sparse Transformers with standard Transformer architectures and other variants, detailing their performance in terms of speed and efficiency during training.

claims.text: The adaptively sparse Transformers (using $ eta$-entmax and 1.5-entmax) achieve 75% and 90% of the training speed of the standard softmax model, respectively.
The method is compared against standard Transformer architecture and two other model variants, indicating a comprehensive evaluation against baselines.
